title: This Codex Skill Finds Your First Customers on Reddit
description:
So someone built a Codex skill that literally finds your first customers for you and honestly i wasnt ready for how clever it is 🔥

You drop in a link to your idea, and it builds an ideal customer profile from that. Then it goes digging trough Reddit, forums and social media for people who are already complaining about the exact problem you solve. Real people, real posts, not some random list.

What you get back is a clean HTML report that ranks the leads and gives you direct links to each post so you can just go talk to them. Three days old and its already trending on GitHub 😅 which kinda tells you how many founders been waiting for something like this ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
